title: AgentMessage
description: Envelope for every message exchanged between the backend and a supervised agent process over stdio/socket. See core/README.md and docs/05-ai-supervisor.md.

correlationId.description: Id of the originating request this message is a response to, if any.

type.description: Discriminator selecting which sibling schema `payload` conforms to.

payload.description: Shape determined by `type` — see heartbeat.schema.json, task-request.schema.json, task-result.schema.json.
